formulas.ascii: Linear auto-domain, gamma=1, sigmoid disabled: lo/hi are min/max of valid finite cells in the statistics window and region (0/0 if empty); invalid input (NaN, optional sentinel, validity==0) gives NaN; if hi>lo output clamp((x-lo)/(hi-lo),0,1); otherwise output 0 if x<lo, 1 if x>hi, else 0.5. Infinities are excluded from statistics but clamp in the apply step. Here DN 0 becomes NaN and valid DN is scaled by 0.0001.
y[i] = sum(x[s(i)..i-1+delta]) mod 2^32; delta=0 exclusive (default), 1 inclusive; s(i) is the last nonzero segment flag or 0.
